name: ats-resume-analyzer
description: Full-stack ATS resume analyzer (React + Express + MongoDB).

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server ci && npm --prefix client ci
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
